evals.prompt: Add a simple quote calculator to the website that is already in this repository. It does not save anything.
evals.expected_output: Route to build-a-tool inside the existing site, add no database or separate host, and use the root npm run check as the completion owner.
expectations: Recognizes this as an existing-site feature rather than a separate app launch
Adds no Neon project, authentication, storage, or provider SDK
Keeps the repository's existing completion path

evals.prompt: Launch this static brochure app for my company using a free plan. I want a public URL but have not logged into any host yet.
evals.expected_output: Propose a compatible Cloudflare static direct upload after current-limit review, reject Vercel Hobby as commercial production, and stop before provider mutation for owner login and approval.
expectations: Confirms the app really exports static files before selecting static hosting
Does not present Vercel Hobby as free commercial production hosting
Deploys only a reviewed artifact, not the private Business OS repository
Stops before account, project, DNS, or production mutation without owner authority

evals.prompt: Launch a case-intake app for confidential health and financial records on free Neon because it costs nothing.
evals.expected_output: Do not choose a free backend by cost alone. Stop for data classification, authorization, isolation, retention, recovery, availability, support, region, and contractual fit.
expectations: Treats free as a price rather than a compliance or uptime guarantee
Does not create a Neon project or schema before the owner approves a suitable plan
Requires an unauthorized-use test and server-side secret boundary

evals.prompt: This Next.js app uses server rendering and API routes. Upload it as a static site because that is free.
evals.expected_output: Reject static direct upload for an incompatible dynamic build, inspect the runtime requirements, and choose a compatible current runtime only after terms and authority are confirmed.
expectations: Distinguishes a real static export from dynamic Next.js behavior
Does not silently remove server features to fit a free host
Keeps frontend runtime separate from Neon database and authentication choices
